title: [EXA-13] Self-referential and undefined `urn:agora:` identifiers
description: Review finding EXA-13: Self-referential and undefined `urn:agora:` identifiers (lens EXA). Location: spec/10-relays.md:593, 617; spec/08-cross-space.md:34-37, 118; spec/07-compliance.md:97, 217, 258; spec/04-access-control.md:133; spec/03-spaces.md:55. Fix: The finding is real. The agora-urn decision covers only registration, not undefined sub-namespaces or self-reference. Keep the reviewer's fixes for `rsa`, `csa`, `msg` and the `agora://` form. For SpaceState, 03:49 anchors identity to the genesis CID, so state that `id` is absent from genesis and equals `agora://<genesis CID>` afterward. Replace the reviewer's DM fix with a simpler one: drop `dmGroupID` and identify DM groups by the descriptor's `mlsGroupID`. It is already stable and only ever appears inside the group or in compliance records. Then change 04:117 from "identified by a `DMGroupCID`" to that. No new `urn:agora:dmgroup:` namespace is needed. Full text: notes/review/EXA-verified.md and notes/review/EXA.md.
close_reason: FIXED per notes/review/reconciliation.md: urn:agora:rsa/csa/msg/dmgroup and dmGroupID/DMGroupCID gone from spec; 03-spaces.md §3.3 l.164 id absent from genesis, later agora://<genesis CID> no trailing slash; 08-cross-space.md agora:// without slash; 07-compliance.md keeps only outerEnvelopeCID; DM groups identified by mlsGroupID (04 §4.6)
